duration.description: Duration of the reframed video. Defaults to matching the source video's duration; set explicitly to 5s or 10s to override.
duration.title: Duration

video_url.description: URL of the source video to reframe (must be 10 seconds or less).
video_url.title: Video Url

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the content to paint into the newly exposed canvas area when reframing to the target aspect ratio.
prompt.title: Prompt

resolution.description: Resolution of the reframed video. Higher resolutions cost more.
resolution.title: Resolution

aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: Target aspect ratio for the reframed video.

source_position.description: Optional normalized source rectangle controlling where the source video sits in the output canvas.

w_norm.description: Width of the source rectangle as a fraction of output width.
w_norm.title: W Norm

y_norm.description: Top edge of the source rectangle as a fraction of output height.
y_norm.title: Y Norm

x_norm.description: Left edge of the source rectangle as a fraction of output width.
x_norm.title: X Norm

h_norm.description: Height of the source rectangle as a fraction of output height.
h_norm.title: H Norm

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

exr_file.description: The generated EXR sidecar when exr_export is true. This may be a single EXR file or a ZIP package depending on Luma's export shape.

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url
